text: Good morning, Central New Jersey. The weather service has a Frost Advisory for parts of the area, so check it before you head out. No crashes nearby right now, but 2 construction zones could slow you down. It's 53°F, Sunny, up to 60°. Trick-or-treating tonight? Bring a flashlight and watch for kids crossing.

weatherAlerts.headline: Frost Advisory issued October 31 at 1:26AM EDT until November 1 at 8:00AM EST by NWS Mount Holly NJ
weatherAlerts.instruction: Take steps now to protect tender plants from the cold.
